perCase.missedNuance: Key adds a second issue I did not independently verify: 'the puck is closer to the side boards than YOU' -- I did not check this specific distance comparison, only the directional-language problem.

perCase.lessonForNextPacket: Reaching/arriving and controlling are separate states regardless of whether the arrival is stated as hypothetical or actual. Check control explicitly, not just whether an event is asserted vs. assumed.

perCase.lessonForNextPacket: Explicitly grammar-check every YOU-subject verb (are/do/have) as its own checklist item, separate from the geometry/logic check -- a question can be numerically correct and still need a grammar repair.
